newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BUDAPEST HAS TWO MYSTERY SHOOTINGS, ONE FATAL.
newsitem.headline: BUDAPEST HAS TWO MYSTERY SHOOTINGS, ONE FATAL.

text.p: One man was killed and another seriously wounded in two shootings with the same gun in Budapest but police said on Thursday they did not know if they were linked to a recent series of shootings and bombings.
"A 40-year-old man who died was clothed in rags but this is all we know about him at the moment," Budapest police spokesman Endre Nagy told Reuters following the shootings on Thursday night.
He added that the other victim, a 21-year-old restaurant cook who was shot through the restaurant window, was in hospital but no longer in critical condition.
Nagy said the shooting of the first man was odd in that the attacker shot the cook through an opaque window which prevented him from identifying his target.

Nagy said the police did not yet know the motivation of the shootings or whether the shootings were linked to a series of bombings and shootings that claimed at least five casualties and caused serious material damage since last September.
Thursday night's shootings happened in the same area where last year several small incendiary devices were set off.
Most of the targets of earlier bombings were restaurants, bars and car showrooms.
